column1: # Kotak pintasan di Ubah instance: Kontrol per instance, Penyimpanan instance.
Pilih layout tombol layar yang selalu dipakai saat memainkan instance ini. "Ikuti global" memakai layout aktif di Pengaturan.
column2: Pick the on-screen button layout that is always used when playing this instance. "Follow global" uses the layout that is active in Settings.

column1: Memakai layout yang aktif di Pengaturan, dan ikut berubah bila layout itu diubah.
column2: Uses the layout that is active in Settings, and changes along with it.

column1: Preset ini punya {0} tombol. Hanya dipakai untuk instance ini; layout global tidak berubah. Tombol yang kamu atur di dalam game ikut tersimpan ke preset ini.
column2: This preset has {0} buttons. It is only used for this instance; the global layout does not change. Buttons you rearrange in-game are saved to this preset.

column1: Mesin Rust memakai layout ini hanya bila "Kontrol Amber" menyala di Pengaturan.
column2: The Rust engine only uses this layout when "Amber controls" is on in Settings.

column1: Buat atau kelola preset di Pengaturan > Kontrol > Preset.
column2: Create or manage presets in Settings > Controls > Presets.

column1: Dunia dan mod tidak pernah dihapus dari sini. Yang dihapus hanya log lama dan laporan crash; latest.log tetap ada.
column2: Worlds and mods are never deleted from here. Only old logs and crash reports are removed; latest.log stays.
